The reading was written by hand to the interpreter's schema (viewer/src/ui/interpret.js), not produced by a model, and the interface says so. A saved key reads any description live instead.
description: A snowstorm. The buses stop at 15:00, so most people leave early; the ones who stay are in for the night. The technician has gone home and the plotter paper runs out at 17:00; the basement shop is closed.

spec.title: Snow day, buses stop at 15:00
spec.summary: Presence stays as planned but everyone leaves two hours earlier; the plotter paper runs out at 17:00 and the basement shop is closed. The engine cannot keep a subset in for the night, so that part is approximated by the ordinary late workers.
